summary: Executed backend and frontend verification for daily journal entries feature set (card visibility, journal page, manual balanced/unbalanced behavior, banking-expense auto journal, per-organization sequencing, and module disable behavior). Requested core flows passed; one auth playbook CORS hardening check failed.

critical.issue: CORS preflight response from public endpoint returns access-control-allow-origin='*' and no access-control-allow-credentials header; explicit credentialed-origin posture check fails.

action_items: Fix public preflight behavior to return explicit allow-origin and allow-credentials headers for auth endpoints.
Re-validate ingress/proxy CORS policy alignment with backend CORSMiddleware settings.

Code-level review confirms admin seed flow now reconciles existing admin password_hash when ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes (idempotent behavior present).
Official Egyptian Tax Authority e-invoice submission remains MOCKED/internal and was not validated as a live external integration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Journal requested flows are passing in API and UI, including module disable/hide and direct route block when journal_entries is disabled. Per-org sequence increment validated by creating entries in both orgs. Remaining open item is public CORS preflight header mismatch.
rca of the issue: RCA for CORS failure: public preflight response is likely terminated/overridden at edge ingress (observed wildcard origin and missing allow-credentials) before/without backend header set expected by credentialed auth policy. Repro: OPTIONS {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/auth/login with Origin and Access-Control-Request-* headers -> returns 204 with '*' and no allow-credentials.
